text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: All right! I'm gonna pray really hard so I can get stronger!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Where are those notes I made earlier? Aha, there. I have to communicate what I want in as much detail as possible.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Uh-oh… I can't read my handwriting!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yawn… Oh, right. I need to get my prayers all sorted out…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Uhhh… I wanna be… strong enough… to pull a… tire…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Um… "I wanna be… strange… enough to… poll a tiger"? Argh, I can't read this at all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser ends up unable to convey her wishes to the powers above.
